slices.focus: Ariana starts curating archival New Orleans playlists for long metadata sessions
slices.summary: After a listening event where people swapped parade songs, Ariana gets a brass band reissue from Clifton and starts curating specific archival New Orleans playlists for metadata cleanup. She plans three task-specific playlists and a song-reference note.
open_loops: Creating three small task-specific playlists (steady entry, relabeling, slow review)
Keeping a tiny running note for songs people mention after events
Letting the music habit settle for a few weeks before adding more structure
